description: This file contains unit tests for transaction recovery scenarios in Orleans with Azure Storage clustering, specifically focusing on transaction recovery after silo failures. It defines the TransactionRecoveryTests class with test initialization, configuration, and specific test cases, along with internal configurator classes for cluster and client setup.

classes.name: TransactionRecoveryTests
classes.description: A test class that evaluates transaction recovery mechanisms after silo failures in an Azure Storage cluster environment. It sets up test configurations, initializes test runners, and contains test cases for graceful and ungraceful silo shutdowns.

classes.name: SiloBuilderConfiguratorUsingAzureClustering
classes.description: A private nested class implementing ISiloConfigurator to configure silos to use Azure Storage clustering with specific test defaults.

classes.name: ClientBuilderConfiguratorUsingAzureClustering
classes.description: A private nested class implementing IClientBuilderConfigurator to configure clients to use Azure Storage clustering with specific test defaults.

methods.name: TransactionRecoveryTests
methods.description: The constructor initializing the test, ensuring preconditions are met and setting up the test output helper.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to initialize test resources, including creating a test runner.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Verifies that prerequisites such as Azure Storage availability are satisfied before tests run.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with specified number of silos and configurator classes for Azure clustering.

methods.name: TransactionWillRecoverAfterRandomSiloGracefulShutdown
methods.description: Test case to verify transaction recovery after a graceful shutdown of random silos.

methods.name: TransactionWillRecoverAfterRandomSiloUnGracefulShutdown
methods.description: Test case to verify transaction recovery after an ungraceful shutdown of silos.
